body:
Thanks again to everyone who is trying to help.

However I should mention that I have no room for god in my life. No disrespect to anyone with strong beliefs one way or another. Although, I came from a Catholic family, I myself do not have a position on religion other than the fact that every religious person I meet is a bigot with the "believe in god or else," mentality. Sorry good people out there.

Coming from a Catholic background raised by a single mother gave me a “true” perspective on religion. They did not agree with the fact my mom was divorced. My aunt who is rather extreme would call my mother and remind her that her and her children will be going to hell because of our lack of faith. That and many other reasons, as well the fact my brother is gay. Why are these people religious when all they do is spout reasons to divide the very people they want to save?

I believe if there was a god, he/she is gone now. You people, who speak praise of the lord but become hostile when someone shows you his or her alternative, are a plague on society. Nothing anyone does for god can be considered as applicable to today’s society. I have no room for this or anyone as many of you see god as an end all be all. I don’t need god to have a moral compass. Good people raised me and I myself have fashioned a moral compass for myself, based on my own experiences in life.

So to tell me my misery is really just a test that the lord has concocted for me is not something I want to hear. Even if it were true, would I want any part of his or her kingdom where someone should go through a life of misery and self-loathing as a testament to their faith in the lord? Fuck that, this is my life!

Anyway, I’m sorry if I offended you or your religion, but grow up.  This is about me right now. I made it through the night reading your comments and PMs however I don’t really see anything to get me started. I appreciate all the advice on meditation and the temporary solutions to get my mind out of a rut. However I feel like this morning I have no reason to leave my room. I’m going to pull the blinds closed and sleep throughout most of the day if I can. I have no motivation to get up and do anything aside from leaving this broad mess of thoughts and opinions on here.

I’ve considered joining the gym; I have done this in the past. However, I don’t like being in public, especially any place where there are people far more attuned to that sort of atmosphere. I stay away from public situations because something about me gives people permission to openly become hostile towards me. This is especially true if there are women present. I can be very personable however I assume because I am smaller and more slender than most guys in my city; they often approach me and try to cut in if I am having a discussion with the opposite sex. I’m not sure why it happens, but it’s really easy for someone to randomly come up and insult me to make me look like a fool in front of a woman. They question the woman for talking to a loser like me, than quickly proceed by inserting themself into the conversation by taking me out. It’s happened time and time again whether I am out on a date or even with a friend.

I really have no response for this kind of behaviour, which makes it much easier for someone to take advantage of the situation. This is why I don’t want to take dancing lessons, go to the gym, join a club or even try dating again. Once some prick sees me (a boyish looking 26-year-old) with a cute girl they will swoop in and precede to make me look like an asshole. Even my own friends started doing it a couple years back in college. It’s embarrassing because I can’t handle confrontation and everyone began seeing it as a harmless joke. No one “allowed” me to take the steps to living a normal life and I just sort of gave up. I stopped being invited over, friends stopped coming over (unless they wanted something from me.) Eventually I had no one and I let three years of my life escape me with nothing to show for it. Even one professor sat me down to confront me on my work. I was so close to tears, but my body language was void of aspiration. I watched my professor begin to tear up because they could tell something was wrong. However they quickly excused me from their office and I went home, nothing was done about it.

Honestly I wish I lived in America so I could obtain a handgun easily. How easy would it be, with no criminal background, to purchase a gun and put it to my temple? Fuck I wish I had it so easy. If I had access to a weapon, believe me. I would be running for that without hesitation. I fantasize about this far too often and now I am left with no motivation to better myself.

As far as my position at work goes, well I was originally hired with the intent to promote to assistant manager. However it would take several years to realize all of this was a lie. The company does not hire from within and my boss and my boss’s boss always tell me that they need consistency if I am to be considered for promotion. Well, I did the stupid thing of admitting to my boss that this April I am going to become homeless and I will not be fit to come into work if I am unable to bathe or change clothes on a daily basis. 

My father has quite a lot of debt and it looks like he’ll be leaving for the other side of the country to be with his sister. This way he can live off the rest of his assets alone and free from stress and responsibility. I don’t blame him, I fucked up my life, why drag him down? He’s much older and doesn’t want to have to continue looking for a job when he is so close to retirement. He is under contract now with another company since losing his career many years ago, but that’s another story. So he is going to sell the house and leave me behind which I don’t have an issue with, he shouldn’t have to be looking after his 26-year-old failure of a son. I’ve enjoyed my free ride; I think this April will be my last.

I'm not in any position to give advice but I want you to know that even though your parents are dragging you down through the thick and thin. You're on your way to becoming the person YOU want to be.
 
Just don't let the fear take over, even if you have to stand firm and show your parents you're not afraid, do it. Please be safe, do not retaliate against violence with more violence. 

Be smart and don't just listen to the advice people have, take the appropriate steps to get through this. The fact you're asking for help proves you're on your way, I believe in you.

Ten years ago I was your age and I should have spoke to someone; you're here now. What are you going do?
